pages.title: Friesian
pages.text: The all-black horse of the Dutch lowlands - tall and powerful, always show-ready.

pages.title: Majestic Presence
pages.text:
Get into the saddle and whatever is chasing you **gives up on the spot** - wolves, polar bears, bees, iron golems, anything neutral within 24 blocks. Mounting a Friesian ends the chase.

While you ride, it keeps them off you: neutral mobs within 12 blocks drop a grudge before it starts. That standing calm won't call off a fight you picked - anything you actually struck stays angry - but the mounting one will.
